name: context-budget
description: Measure a Claude Code session's fixed startup context payload per item, on the consumer's machine at a pinned, version-stamped binary, including per-tool attribution of the built-in tool pools that /context reports only as lump sums, derived live by A/B bare-name-deny differencing with enforced comparability rules (skill-listing signature, one mode, one binary), an SDK-primary exact meter degrading to a version-aware headless /context parser and then to an honest structured error (never a wrong number), and a per-project measure-toggle-remeasure ledger under the plugin data directory recording every lever's real before/after delta. Report-only by default; `fix` applies one approved project-scope trim.

settings_write_ask_enabled.title: Settings-write-ask hook
settings_write_ask_enabled.description: Runs the PreToolUse hook that asks before Write, Edit, and NotebookEdit calls aimed at a Claude Code settings file. On by default. Shell writes and files rendered into place are outside its matcher.
